body:
Trees gain rounded foliage lighting, light passing through leaves, and finer close twigs in Full. Vegetation follows spring, summer, fall and winter in 1812, 1835, 1871 and 1904: evergreen conifers, dated flowers and vines, and bare winter branches. The 1871 scene opens on 8 October, respects explicit season choices, and keeps the Great Fire sequence in fall.

The remaining 3,543 solid 1871 crowns, including the Water Tower context, become branching seasonal trees. Recorded positions, dimensions, cards, confidence grades and citations are preserved. Planting locations retain their recorded reconstruction status.

Light uses a cheaper environment approximation for uniform matte surfaces. Mapped and per-vertex roughness keep their physical lighting; Full and Balanced retain their physical shaders. Geometry, density, cutouts, wind and performance limits are preserved.

Validation for current head `e4ec8d6b6`:

- [Combined Dev source and committed preflight](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/main/evidence/vegetation-realism-2026-11-25/candidate-2026-11-26/dev-2423-final-batch-preflight): all original tree edits are independently preserved over actual Dev `fe71576d8`, including the streamed controls, 1812 carried goods and 1871 street furniture. Preflight passes in 261.6 seconds; upstream records and canonical metadata are preserved.
- The [full current-head Native gate](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/46119797196) passed, covering 1,455 declared steps on the actual combined PR checkout. All 15 published browser sections completed at both viewports: 1,565 assertions passed, zero failures and zero page errors. Human/moving/upload regressions and all 15 stock report jobs passed.
- Stock reports preserve the original CPU-specific policy. Registered limits pass unchanged; desktop timing on the unregistered CPU remains an unheld measurement under the existing warn-only policy.
- [Desktop navigation failure and single retry](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/main/evidence/vegetation-realism-2026-11-25/candidate-2026-11-26/dev-2423-desktop-navigation-negative): the first complete desktop 1–4 run passed 320 checks but failed its final zero-page-error assertion on six blob fetch refusals at version-to-default navigation. That unchanged harness navigation matches the documented picture-cancellation race; diagnosis is circumstantial. The [one unchanged retry](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/46119865006/attempts/2) completed all 321 checks with zero failures and zero page errors. Source, full body, assertions and limits are unchanged. No current pass is borrowed from preceding heads.
- [Original feature qualification](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/main/evidence/vegetation-realism-2026-11-25/candidate-2026-11-26/roughness-channel-qualified-source): all 1,441 Native steps and every eligible predefined EPYC 7763/4 calibration passed the original limits before seasonal authorship. Those are historical `6b39988` measurements.
- [96 seasonal views and same-date Water Tower controls](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/main/evidence/vegetation-realism-2026-11-25/candidate-2026-11-26/light-fix-all-years-seasons) retain their original source identity. Earlier actual negatives and their corrections remain in the adjacent evidence folders.

Core's completed dependency from closed, unmerged #2358 is included in this group. Merge follows complete green combined-head CI. Target: Dev preview.
